description: Audit note from PR #181 (2026-08-20): default_get_shard_layout (materializer_bootstrap_phase.ex) reads the shard_keys/ family with limit: 1000 and discards the _more continuation flag. Beyond 1000 shards the layout silently truncates. With carried start keys the truncation at least yields a visibly holey layout instead of a plausible-but-wrong contiguous one, but the read needs to loop the continuation (or page) before shard counts grow. Pre-existing, surfaced during bedrock-q67.41.
title: Bound the bootstrap shard-layout read: consume the continuation past 1000 entries
